gamerule.natural-reproduction:enabled.de: When true, passive animals breed autonomously when fed and in proximity to mates.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:density_ca: Maximum number of animals of the same species allowed in a 16-block radius for autonomous breeding to occur.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:rate.descr: Average tick interval between autonomous breeding attempts per animal (24000 = 1 MC Day).
gamerule.natural-reproduction:scale_drop: When true, animal item drops scale proportionally with the animal's physical scale attribute.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:cramped_sp: When true, breeding in small 4x4 enclosures stunting offspring scale down to 0.25x; breeding in spacious pastures recovers size genetics.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:inbreeding: When true, repeated closed-herd inbreeding degrades genetics across tiers down to lethal collapse.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:pasture_en: When true, pastures with feeding troughs, hay bales, water, and barn shelter grant well-nourished breeding and size bonuses.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:overgrazin: When true, high herd crowding on grass blocks converts grass into dirt/coarse dirt.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:gestation_: When true, breeding enters mothers into a pregnancy countdown before delivering offspring.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:manual_ges: When true, player manual feeding also uses pregnancy gestation timers.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:gestation_: Pregnancy gestation duration in ticks (24000 = 1 MC Day).
gamerule.natural-reproduction:fertilized: When true, chicken autonomous breeding rolls 50/50 for immediate chicks or laying guaranteed-hatch Fertilized Eggs.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:chicken_in: When true, ordinary unfertilized chicken eggs have a reduced 1/64 miracle hatch chance.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:dispenser_: Percentage chance (0-100%) for a dispenser-fired Fertilized Egg to hatch a baby chick.
item.natural-reproduction.fertilized_egg: Guaranteed to hatch a baby chick
gamerule.natural-reproduction:herd_dynam: When true, animals form pastoral herds led by the largest Alpha animal with diurnal schedule cohesion.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:herd_stamp: When true, damage from predators or players alerts nearby herd members to stampede away in unison.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:biome_fert: When true, animals in native biomes get 2x faster breeding frequency and +15% offspring genetics quality.
gamerule.natural-reproduction:biome_vari: When true, offspring born in specific biomes dynamically adapt their visual entity variant skin (e.g. Snowy Wolves, Desert Frogs).
gamerule.natural-reproduction:normal_sca: Standard baseline animal scale percentage (95 = 0.95x scale).
gamerule.natural-reproduction:tracker_lo: When true, autonomous animal reproduction events are recorded to the tracker log and server console.
